lessons.short: 场景 1：收到一句模糊需求
lessons.context: 产品同事说“在页面上加个导出功能”，没有明确导出当前页还是全部结果，也没提权限。你正准备开始写代码。
lessons.cn: 开始实施前，你需要先确认什么？
lessons.suggestion: 开始前我想确认两点：导出当前页还是全部结果？另外，哪些用户可以使用这个功能？
lessons.reason: 澄清影响方案的范围与权限，避免各自按默认理解开发后返工。先问会改变实现的关键问题，不必一次追问所有细节。
lessons.pro: Before I start, could we clarify whether the export should include the current page or all results, and which users should have access?
lessons.casual: Quick check before I dive in: can we clarify whether we're exporting this page or everything? And who should be able to use it?
lessons.explain: could we clarify 用于邀请共同澄清；Quick check 是轻量开场。沟通目的可以严谨，措辞仍然自然。
lessons.variant: 已经确认过的需求，不必机械地重新对齐。若只有一个有疑问的点，直接问那个点。
lessons.fix: 只说 I’ll add an export button 会掩盖尚未明确的范围。先提出具体分歧，而不是泛泛说 let’s align。

lessons.context: 你答应周五交付，但依赖团队原定今天提供的接口还没准备好。现在没有替代方案，距离周五还有两天。
lessons.cn: 现在应该同步哪些信息？
lessons.suggestion: 提前同步一下：接口还没准备好，周五交付可能受影响。我正在和对方确认时间，明天下午会再更新。
lessons.reason: 发现实质风险时，而不是等到延期已成事实。表达已知事实、对交付的影响、你正做的事与下一次更新时间；不要把风险说成确定结论。
lessons.pro: A quick heads-up: the API isn’t ready yet, which puts Friday’s delivery at risk. I’m checking the timeline with the other team and will share an update tomorrow afternoon.
lessons.casual: Just a heads-up—the API’s still not ready, so Friday might be tight. I’m checking with the team and I’ll update you tomorrow afternoon.
lessons.explain: heads-up 是提前告知；at risk 表示有风险，而不是已经确定失败。给出下一次更新时间能减少反复追问。
lessons.variant: 如果延期已确认，应直接说明更新后的计划；若连时间也未知，明确说何时能提供下一次进展。
lessons.fix: 只说 The other team is late 容易停留在归责。补上对交付的影响、行动和更新节点。

lessons.context: 你正在赶一个今天到期的任务，经理又请你今天处理另一件事。两件都做不完，经理可能不知道原任务还需要多少时间。
lessons.cn: 怎样让经理做出知情的优先级选择？
lessons.suggestion: 我可以先处理这件事，不过原任务就需要推到明天。你希望我优先做哪一个？
lessons.reason: 让工作取舍可见。先说明容量与具体代价，再请对方确认优先级，避免默默承诺两件都完成或只说“忙不过来”。
lessons.pro: I can prioritize this, but that would move the current task to tomorrow. Which one would you like me to focus on first?
lessons.casual: I can prioritize this now, but the other task would have to wait until tomorrow. Which one comes first?
lessons.explain: prioritize / focus on first 直接讨论顺序；but that would... 说明取舍，语气无需防御。
lessons.variant: 如果你有明确建议，可以补 I’d suggest finishing the current task first because...，再邀请确认。
lessons.fix: 只说 I’m too busy 没有给出选择依据。说明具体影响，再询问先后顺序。

lessons.context: 会议讨论越来越发散，只剩十分钟，还没确定谁做什么。
lessons.suggestion: 我们先回到今天需要决定的事情上，最后留两分钟确认行动项和负责人。
lessons.reason: 先肯定讨论的价值，再把话题拉回要做出的决定；结尾确认负责人和下一步。
lessons.pro: Could we refocus on the decision we need to make today and leave two minutes to confirm the action items and owners?
lessons.casual: Can we refocus on today's decision? Let's save two minutes for next steps and who's doing what.
lessons.explain: 训练目标：先识别沟通时机、说清具体问题，再选择适合关系与场合的英文。
lessons.variant: 参考表达是一种可行方式；请按实际事实、权限与时间调整，不必逐字背诵。
lessons.fix: 避免只表达模糊态度。补齐当前事实、影响和明确的请求或下一步。

lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? My apology for the oversight. Please allow me to take a moment to remediate it. It does not align with my preferences or interests

prompt.scenarioZh: 会议讨论越来越发散，只剩十分钟，还没确定谁做什么。

answer.chinese: 我们先回到今天需要决定的事情上，最后留两分钟确认行动项和负责人。

english.professional: Could we refocus on the decision we need to make today and leave two minutes to confirm the action items and owners?
english.casual: Can we refocus on today's decision? Let's save two minutes for next steps and who's doing what.

lessons.suggestion: 我这周已经排满了。这个最晚什么时候需要？如果不急，我下周可以开始。
lessons.reason: 说明当前容量，问清紧急程度，提供可行时点；不默默接下，也不只说“不归我管”。
lessons.pro: I’m at capacity this week. When is this needed? If it isn’t urgent, I can start next week.
lessons.casual: I'm at capacity this week. When do you need it? I could pick it up next week if that works.

lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? 商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? prompt.scenarioZh: 经理表扬了你交付的功能，但设计和后端同事也有重要贡献。
prompt.questionZh: 你会怎样回应这份表扬？

answer.chinese: 谢谢！设计和后端团队也帮了很多，尤其是提前解决了接口问题。

english.professional: Thank you. The design and backend teams made important contributions, particularly by resolving the API issues early.
english.casual: Thanks! Design and backend made a big contribution—they helped sort out the API issues early on.

lessons.short: 迁移没那么顺，中间碰到了几个小问题。
lessons.cn: 迁移没那么顺，中间碰到了几个小问题。
lessons.suggestion: 迁移没那么顺，中间碰到了几个小问题。
lessons.pro: We hit a few bumps during the migration.
lessons.casual: We hit a few bumps during the migration.
lessons.explain: 本句用 hit a few bumps 表达“遇到了一些波折”。结合完整句子记忆搭配，而不只背孤立的中文标签。 这句本身是中性表达，可用于专业和一般对话；两版相同时无需刻意改写。
lessons.variant: 另一个表达方向是 encountered a few setbacks。示例：We encountered a few setbacks during the migration.。替换后仍要核对主语、时态和语气，不能当作所有场景的等号。
lessons.fix: 不要把“遇到了一些波折”按中文字序拼接。本题参考搭配为 hit a few bumps；完整语境是 We hit a few bumps during the migration.

lessons.explain: I’d love to, but... 先表达意愿，再解释限制，比层层否定更顺。take a rain check 表示这次先不了、希望改天，不代表约定了具体日期。

lessons.context: 远程会议中声音不连续，你请同事重复。
lessons.suggestion: 你这声音一断一断的，能再说一遍吗？

lessons.pro: Your audio is choppy. Could you repeat that?
lessons.casual: Your audio is choppy. Could you repeat that?
lessons.explain: choppy 形容声音断续不流畅；is breaking up 描述音频正在断断续续。当前句子可改写，但它们不是同一词性，不能在所有位置互换。
lessons.variant: 另一个表达方向是 breaking up。示例：Your audio is breaking up. Could you repeat that?。替换后仍要核对主语、时态和语气，不能当作所有场景的等号。
lessons.fix: choppy 指不连贯、断断续续；lagging 则偏延迟。

lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

lessons.context: 你向同事说明临时可用但需要手工操作的方案。

lessons.pro: We have a workaround, but it requires a manual restart.
lessons.casual: We have a workaround, but it requires a manual restart.
lessons.explain: workaround 比 temporary alternative 更明确：绕过已知问题，让流程先跑起来；不一定修复根因。plan B 是备用计划，即便没出故障也可能存在。

lessons.body:
日期：（洛杉矶） ## 中文练习 场景：职场沟通——接到需求后，开始实施前向同事确认理解。
开始做之前，我想先确认一下，我们对这个需求的理解是一致的。
先花一分钟自行翻译，再看下面的参考答案。 --- ## 练习后再看 专业版
Before I get started, I’d like to confirm that we have the same understanding of this requirement.
口语版
Before I dive in, I just want to make sure we’re on the same page about this requirement. ## 关键表达 - be on the same page about something：对某件事有一致理解，常用于确认需求、计划或分工；职场中也很常用。 - dive in：开始投入做某事，比 get started 更口语。 ## 生硬译法改进 生硬：Before doing it, I want to confirm our understandings are consistent.
自然：Before I get started, I’d like to confirm that we have the same understanding.
原因：Before doing it 指代模糊；our understandings are consistent 虽能理解，却像逐字翻译。英语中更常说 have the same understanding 或 be on the same page。 ## Markdown 表达日志 ```markdown ### 2026-10-22｜职场：确认理解一致 - 中文：开始做之前，我想先确认一下，我们对这个需求的理解是一致的。 - 专业版：Before I get started, I’d like to confirm that we have the same understanding of this requirement. - 口语版：Before I dive in, I just want to make sure we’re on the same page about this requirement. - 关键表达：be on the same page = 对某事有一致理解；dive in = 开始投入做某事。 - 改进：把 “our understandings are consistent” 改为 “we have the same understanding” 或 “we’re on the same page”，更符合英语习惯。 ```

lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

lessons.short: 解决细节中的分歧或问题
lessons.context: 团队准备马上实施，但错误处理和边界条件还没讨论清楚。
lessons.suggestion: 我们把剩下的实施细节敲定。
lessons.reason: 还存在具体细节分歧，继续讨论能推进实施。
lessons.pro: Let's iron out the remaining implementation details.
lessons.casual: Let's iron out the remaining implementation details.
lessons.explain: iron out 在这句话中表达“解决细节中的分歧或问题”。还存在具体细节分歧，继续讨论能推进实施。 这句本身是中性表达，可用于专业和一般对话；两版相同时无需刻意改写。
lessons.variant: 近义表达方向：resolve the details。实际替换时需要重新检查句法和语气。
lessons.fix: 保留要表达的目的，用 iron out 组织英语；不要机械照搬原笔记的残缺句或过度正式说法。
lessons.origin: 商务英语长笔记拆分训练
lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? My apology for the oversight. Please allow me to take a moment to remediate it. It does not align with my preferences or interests

商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? My apology for the oversight. Please allow me to take a moment to remediate it. It does not align with my preferences or interests

prompt.scenarioZh: 上线前评审快结束了，你想最后核对是否还有重要风险未被注意。
prompt.expressionZh: 我们再检查一下，有没有忽略重大风险。
prompt.clozeEn: Let's double-check that we haven't ____ any major risks.

answer.chinese: 我们再检查一下，有没有忽略重大风险。
answer.english: Let's double-check that we haven't overlooked any major risks.

contextNotes.why: overlook 在这句话中表达“疏忽、未注意到”。评审风险时核对遗漏，而非假定清单完整。 这句本身是中性表达，可用于专业和一般对话；两版相同时无需刻意改写。
contextNotes.variation: 近义表达方向：miss。实际替换时需要重新检查句法和语气。
contextNotes.literalImprovement: 保留要表达的目的，用 overlook 组织英语；不要机械照搬原笔记的残缺句或过度正式说法。

lessons.fix: 保留要表达的目的，用 troubleshoot 组织英语；不要机械照搬原笔记的残缺句或过度正式说法。

lessons.context: 新端点已经上线，客户问旧端点什么时候停止使用。
lessons.suggestion: 我们会在未来一个月逐步停用旧端点。
lessons.reason: 迁移通知要说明旧接口停用节奏。
lessons.pro: We're phasing out the old endpoint over the next month.
lessons.casual: We're phasing out the old endpoint over the next month.

lessons.origin: 商务英语长笔记拆分训练
lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? My apology for the oversight. Please allow me to take a moment to remediate it. It does not align with my preferences or interests

lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? lessons.reason: 要求简洁的信息同步。
lessons.pro: Let's keep the update short and sweet.
lessons.casual: Let's keep the update short and sweet.
lessons.explain: short and sweet 在这句话中表达“简短而清楚”。要求简洁的信息同步。 这句本身是中性表达，可用于专业和一般对话；两版相同时无需刻意改写。
lessons.variant: 近义表达方向：brief and clear。实际替换时需要重新检查句法和语气。
lessons.fix: 保留要表达的目的，用 short and sweet 组织英语；不要机械照搬原笔记的残缺句或过度正式说法。
lessons.origin: 商务英语长笔记拆分训练
lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? My apology for the oversight. Please allow me to take a moment to remediate it. It does not align with my preferences or interests

lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? prompt.expressionZh: 这个工具一开始需要学的东西很多。
prompt.clozeEn: There's ____ with this tool.
prompt.hintZh: 需要在短时间内学习很多内容

answer.chinese: 这个工具一开始需要学的东西很多。
answer.english: There's a steep learning curve with this tool.

contextNotes.why: a steep learning curve 在这句话中表达“需要在短时间内学习很多内容”。描述上手学习压力，不是断言无法掌握。 这句本身是中性表达，可用于专业和一般对话；两版相同时无需刻意改写。
contextNotes.variation: 近义表达方向：a demanding initial learning period。实际替换时需要重新检查句法和语气。
contextNotes.literalImprovement: 保留要表达的目的，用 a steep learning curve 组织英语；不要机械照搬原笔记的残缺句或过度正式说法。

cloze.sentenceEn: There's ____ with this tool.
cloze.hintZh: 需要在短时间内学习很多内容

lessons.context: 同事刚分析完根因，与你掌握的证据完全吻合，你肯定他的判断。
lessons.suggestion: 你的分析非常准确。
lessons.reason: 简短认可具体判断。
lessons.pro: Your analysis was spot on.
lessons.casual: Your analysis was spot on.
lessons.explain: spot on 在这句话中表达“非常准确、说到点上”。简短认可具体判断。 这句本身是中性表达，可用于专业和一般对话；两版相同时无需刻意改写。
lessons.variant: 近义表达方向：exactly right。实际替换时需要重新检查句法和语气。
lessons.fix: 保留要表达的目的，用 spot on 组织英语；不要机械照搬原笔记的残缺句或过度正式说法。
lessons.origin: 商务英语长笔记拆分训练
lessons.body:
商务英语 走入工厂的日常(What your team/company/industry do) - 一般工作行为 - 信息相关 - 信息综合-开会 - 信息同步-跟进 - 信息创造-脑暴 - 信息提交-发表意见 - chime in积极发表意见 - 项目管理相关 - 项目-conception & initiation - kick off the marketing campaign - 项目-defining & planning - 项目-launch & execution - iron out the implementation detail - 项目-performance & control - 项目-closing & retrospect - 专业工作行为 - 财务预算 - scale back the budget, scale back the team size for efficiency - 活动发起 - 设计 - 数据统计 - 软件开发 - 系统管理 做漂亮事，说漂亮话(do good, say beautiful) STAR: 什么背景下面对什么问题；什么行为带来什么效果

B以P: 什么行为以达什么效果(to) keep chasing up the feedback/progress in case the project is behind schedule

B来B: 什么行为来推进什么行为(to) 不想背锅就不要错过(Heads up!) NOTE: 以下这些“道理”或许你已经听过，也试过，并没有对工作完成或效率有多大改善。对的，没毛病！它不一定能解决你的问题，但你需要会说你会很懂这些招数，至少你在面试/介绍/分享的时候。 ### 个人心得类 - 敲定执行细节后再进行；换言之，没有细节留待你发挥的事最好别做 - sorry to cut in but my perspective is we need discussion before we move forward - nail down the implementation detail before proceed - dont rush into the implementation, sleep on this decision before I commit to it ### 大而笼统类 - 太多的时候：精简并专注 - streamline the meeting agenda to focus on key discussion - 太难的时候：分治，让任务再小一些 - break down the requirements into smaller pieces - 落脚点从自己到对方 - that is outside the scope of my responsibilities我的职责范围之外 - I am not certain, but I will look into it and get back to you我不确定，但我会研究一下，然后给您答复 - I am afraid I am not quite following. Could you please clarify?恐怕我不太明白。能否请您澄清一下？ - I dont agree→ I understand your perspective, but I have a different view on this. - 责任方从他人到自己 - Does that make sense to you?你觉得有道理吗？→ Please let me know if you have any questions - You are wrong → I respect your opinion, but I think there could be a mistake here. 我尊重你的意见，但我认为这里面可能有误会。 - That’s a bad idea → I’m not entirely convinced that’s the best approach. Maybe we could explore other possibilities? - Could you elaborate on that? → To ensure we’re on the same page, could you elaborate further? - Mind your business → Thank you for your input but I have got this under controle

sync up later this week to go over the project timeline 本周晚些时候同步下进度，讨论下项目时间表 do not leave out any potential risk in assessment report 不要在评估报告中遗漏任何潜在风险

slack off 懈怠、偷懒或减少努力 no time to slack off 时不我待 tasks are starting to pile up 任务开始堆积 brush me off

illustrate the concept with a real-life example 举例说明概念 double check and make sure not to overlook any potential risk 仔细检查，确保不忽视任何潜在风险 troubleshoot the network issue 排除网络故障 we are phasing out underperforming products swing by顺便经过 短暂停留 swing by your desk and drop off the proposal 到你的办公桌前递上建议书

catch on to 搞懂，理解 It took a while for me to catch on to the system 我花了一段时间才掌握了系统

patch up the misunderstandings between the sales and marketing teams hash out let’s hash out the budget allocation/the contract terms

allocate tasks to team members 为团队成员分配任务 without further ado 话不多说 turn over all the documents relevant 交出所有相关文件 - create content that resonates with our target client digress偏离，跑题 We are digressing. Let’s stay focused on the main agenda and the key objectives.

metric key performance metric

penetration渗透率 increase penetration indicate a steady increase segue let’s segue into the upcoming product launch strategy让我们来谈谈即将推出的产品战略

rock the boat惹麻烦，制造麻烦 short and sweet简洁明了 keep the action items short and sweet and get straight to the point 行动项目要简明扼要，直奔主题 black and white明确清晰，一清二楚 make sure the contract terms black and white 确保合同条款明确清晰 high and dry置于困境 left sb high and dry apples and oranges无法相比，不能相提并论 The resources of two teams are apples and oranges 两支队伍的资源天差地别

kick off

level with 【当你不同意领导的方案】不要直接表达对方案的不同意，而是客观阐述接下来可能出面临的挑战或后果。 I have to level with you about the challenges we would face if we rush to meet the deadlines for our project. Can we level with each other and find a compromise on this issue? 在这个问题上，我们能不能平心静气地达成妥协？

【当参加远程会议走神时被cue时】Sorry you audio seems to be breaking up. Could you please repeat your ask? 很抱歉，您的音频似乎中断了。您能重复一下您的问题吗？ Your screen is frozen. Could you please check your connection? Your voice is choppy. /There’s an echo when you talk./ There’s a lot of background noise on your end./ I think you’re on mute. Your video is lagging./ Your screen is blurry./ I can’t see you; your screen is black.

There’s a delay in your responses./

fall short未达到预期，不尽人意 fell short in delivering the expected code quality standards fell short in meeting the monthly targets

【当表扬你的时候】I am excited to be a part of it. A big shoutout to the team for the hard work and dedication 【当你觉得对方的信息没有什么帮助时】Thanks for sharing helpful insights. Your input is really helpful. 【当你需要对方的反馈】I appreciate you taking the time to listen and provide feedback. It’s.been a pleasure working with you.

Thanks for helping us navigate through these challenges.

a smooth/steep learning curve 平稳/陡峭的学习曲线 on a learning curve 不断学习

be spot on The market analysis was spot on The report was spot on The presentation was spot on

with all due respect

at your earliest convenience give my regards to sb. I imagine that will work

No way —> I am not sure it is feasible I am not sure that could be implemented within the given timescale I was not involved with the project It will be tight, but I’ll try to schedule it in draw up a budget proposal/document

initiate initiate a working session outsource the task to a professional firm conform to the latest industry standard and the budget allocated by the management team

orchestrate a product launch

compromise on the budget allocation to ensure smooth execution of the project carry out the performance evaluation step in and negotiated the terms of the contract personally hand in your report EOD

bail out bail out the project

Please key in your personal information to complete your registration process burn out

clutter minimize the cluster

step through step through the procedure

step through the agenda

cook up编造，策划 cook up excuses delve into深入研究 delve into the project requirements square away square away the final details of the proposal square away the paperwork strip out

strip out the unnecessary details or irrelevant information

outline

The approach might be insufficient to fully obtain our objectives It is unfortunate that the current outcome has not fully met my initial expectations I am afraid I might not proceed with this course of action after careful consideration 因住滴好喔—》 May I suggest we consider proceeding with this approach after careful deliberation? My apology for the oversight. Please allow me to take a moment to remediate it. It does not align with my preferences or interests

contextNotes.why: feasible 在这句话中表达“可行的”。讨论可行性，而不是简单说“不可能”。 这句本身是中性表达，可用于专业和一般对话；两版相同时无需刻意改写。
